{{Short description|Danish physicist (born 1972)}}
'''Ulrik Lund Andersen''' (born 1972) is a Danish physicist and professor of physics at the Department of Physics at the [[Technical University of Denmark]] (DTU), who researches [[quantum optics]] and [[quantum network]]s. He is the head of quantum information group has been serving as the director of center of ''bigQ -'' Center for Macroscopic Quantum States since January 2018.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Center for Macroscopic Quantum States (BigQ),Technical University of Denmark,DNRF |url=https://dg.dk/en/centers/center-for-macroscopic-quantum-states-bigq/ |access-date=2025-10-01 |website=Danish National Research Foundation |language=en-US}}</ref><ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Ulrik Lund Andersen |url=https://orbit.dtu.dk/en/persons/ulrik-lund-andersen |access-date=2025-09-30 |website=Welcome to DTU Research Database |language=en-GB}}</ref>

== Education, career and awards ==
He went to Ikast-Brande Gymnasium high school. He received a Master of Science in Applied Physics from DTU in 1999 and a Ph.D. also from DTU in 2003. He was a [[Postdoctoral researcher|postdoc]] and [[Assistant professor|Assistant Professor]] and at the [[University of Erlangen–Nuremberg]] in Germany from 2003-2006, and was then employed as an [[associate professor]] at DTU from 2006-2012. In 2012, he was appointed as a full professor and section leader at DTU Physics.<ref>{{cite web |title=Ulrik Lund Andersen |url=https://ufm.dk/forskning-og-innovation/forskningsformidling/eliteforsk/prismodtagere/tidligere-prismodtagere/prismodtagere-2013/ulrik-lund-andersen |website=ufm.dk |publisher=Ministry of Education and Research |access-date=18 March 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Ulrik Lund Andersen |url=https://dff.dk/forskningsprojekter/forskningsleder/topforsker/2015/ulrik-lund-andersen |publisher=The Danish Independent Research Foundation |access-date=18 March 2021 |archive-date=28 January 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210128185846/https://dff.dk/forskningsprojekter/forskningsleder/topforsker/2015/ulrik-lund-andersen |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name=":0" />

He is co-founder and scientific advisor of Alea Technologies and DIASENSE.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Quantum technology for mobile phone encryption is coming |url=https://www.eurekalert.org/news-releases/989999 |access-date=2025-10-01 |website=EurekAlert! |language=en}}</ref>

In 2013, Andersen received the [[EliteForsk Prize]] in recognition of his work on quantum optics.<ref>{{cite web |author1=Ingeborg Nielsen |date=7 February 2013 |title=EliteForsk Award Winners 2013 |url=https://ufm.dk/forskning-og-innovation/forskningsformidling/eliteforsk/prismodtagere/tidligere-prismodtagere/prismodtagere-2013/prismodtagere-2013 |access-date=18 March 2021 |website=Ministry of Higher Education and Science |publisher=Technical University of Denmark - DTU}}</ref>
